```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# LEGEND NUMBERS — helper
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Each panel writes the sample sizes and test details its legend needs to the
# console AND to one text file. The file is overwritten on every run.
LEGEND_FILE <- "Figure2_legend_numbers.txt"
cat("Figure 2 — legend numbers\n",
    "Generated: ", format(Sys.time()), "\n", file = LEGEND_FILE, sep = "")

legend_out <- function(title, x = NULL) {
  body <- if (is.null(x)) character(0)
          else if (is.character(x)) x
          else utils::capture.output(print(as.data.frame(x), row.names = FALSE))
  txt <- c("", paste0("=== ", title, " ==="), body)
  cat(txt, sep = "\n")
  cat(txt, sep = "\n", file = LEGEND_FILE, append = TRUE)
  invisible(NULL)
}

# n samples / n infants, optionally by group
n_si <- function(df, ..., id = "MM_ID") {
  df %>% dplyr::group_by(...) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_samples = dplyr::n(),
                     n_infants = dplyr::n_distinct(.data[[id]]), .groups = "drop")
}
```

```{r}
# Load the data
metadata <- read.table("meta_with_placental_subtypes.txt", header = TRUE, quote = "\"", na.strings = c("NA", ""), stringsAsFactors = FALSE, comment.char = "")
taxa_cleaned <- read.delim("taxa_cleaned_jan.txt")
row.names(taxa_cleaned)<-taxa_cleaned$ID
taxa_cleaned$ID=NULL
row.names(metadata)<-metadata$ID
metadata_infant <- metadata[grep("^B", rownames(metadata)), ]
taxa_infant <- taxa_cleaned[grep("^B", rownames(taxa_cleaned)), ]

# Factors (categorical/binary variables)
factor_vars <- c("prolonged_rupt", "surgery", "ab48", "multiple", "delivery_md",
                 "maternal_atb", "mother_st_com", "placenta_ab", "pe_hellp",
                 "maternal_infect", "mother_b_hem", "nec",
                 "sex", "sip", "sepsis_culture", "pda_sign", "mortality",
                 "pda", "probiotics", "SGA", "LGA", "FGR", "ivh", "abtx")

# Numeric (continuous variables)
numeric_vars <- c("mmpercentage", "probiotic_sample","apgar_1", "apgar_5", "antibiotic_sample", "ga_exact", "bw", "admissiontime", "tpn_days", "TFEF_B", "TFEF", "DNA_conc","Clean_reads_P1", "week", "Postnatal_Age", "MM_ID" )

# Apply to dataframe
metadata_infant[factor_vars] <- lapply(metadata_infant[factor_vars], as.factor)
metadata_infant[numeric_vars] <- lapply(metadata_infant[numeric_vars], as.numeric)

# Verify
str(metadata_infant[, c(factor_vars, numeric_vars)])

taxa=taxa_infant[row.names(taxa_infant)%in% rownames(metadata_infant),] # Only taxa present in infants 
setdiff (rownames(taxa), rownames(metadata_infant)) # all good 

taxa_sp=taxa
taxa_sp=taxa_sp[,grep("s__",colnames(taxa_sp))]
taxa_sp=taxa_sp[,-grep("t__",colnames(taxa_sp))]
taxa_sub_species<-taxa[,grep("t__",colnames(taxa))]

taxa_genus=taxa
taxa_genus=taxa_genus[,grep("g__",colnames(taxa_genus))]
taxa_genus=taxa_genus[,-grep("s__",colnames(taxa_genus))]

#Simplify names
colnames(taxa_sp)=gsub(".*s__","",colnames(taxa_sp))
colnames(taxa_sub_species)=gsub(".*t__","",colnames(taxa_sub_species))
colnames(taxa_genus)=gsub(".*g__","",colnames(taxa_genus))

# Probiotic species are removed before diversity and distance calculations.
PROBIOTIC_SPECIES <- c("Bifidobacterium_longum", "Bifidobacterium_animalis",
                       "Streptococcus_thermophilus")
legend_out("Probiotic species removed from the species table (TRUE = column existed)",
           data.frame(species = PROBIOTIC_SPECIES,
                      present = PROBIOTIC_SPECIES %in% colnames(taxa_sp)))
taxa_sp <- taxa_sp[, !colnames(taxa_sp) %in% PROBIOTIC_SPECIES, drop = FALSE]

taxa_sp <- taxa_sp %>% mutate(across(everything(), ~ as.numeric(.)))
taxa_sub_species <- taxa_sub_species %>% mutate(across(everything(), ~ as.numeric(.)))

richness <- plyr::ddply(taxa_sp,~rownames(taxa_sp),function(x) {
  data.frame(RICHNESS=sum(x[-1]>0, na.rm = T))})
row.names(richness)<-richness$`rownames(taxa_sp)`
richness$`rownames(taxa_sp)`=NULL
my_alpha_diversity=data.frame(Shannon=diversity(taxa_sp, index = "shannon"), Simpson=diversity(taxa_sp, index = "simpson"))
my_alpha_diversity=merge(my_alpha_diversity, richness, by="row.names")
row.names(my_alpha_diversity)=my_alpha_diversity$Row.names
my_alpha_diversity$Row.names=NULL

phenos_imputed_div=merge(my_alpha_diversity, metadata_infant, by="row.names")
row.names(phenos_imputed_div)=phenos_imputed_div$Row.names
phenos_imputed_div$Row.names=NULL

taxa_sp$ID<-row.names(taxa_sp)
taxa_sp$personal_ID<-sub ("_.*",  "",  taxa_sp$ID)
unique_counts <- sapply(taxa_sp, function(x) length(unique(taxa_sp$personal_ID[x >0.05]))) 
taxa_sp_filt <- taxa_sp[, unique_counts >= 1]  
taxa_sp_filt$personal_ID=NULL
taxa_sp_filt$ID=NULL

#CLR Transformations
my_pseudocount_normal=min(taxa_sp_filt[taxa_sp_filt!=0])/2

# Align the taxa table to the phenotype table by row name.
stopifnot(setequal(row.names(taxa_sp_filt), row.names(phenos_imputed_div)))
taxa_sp_filt <- taxa_sp_filt[row.names(phenos_imputed_div), , drop = FALSE]
my_distance_CLR=vegdist(taxa_sp_filt, method = "aitchison", pseudocount=my_pseudocount_normal) 
taxa_sp_filt_CLR <- decostand(taxa_sp_filt, "clr", pseudocount=my_pseudocount_normal)
mypcoa_CLR=cmdscale(my_distance_CLR, k = 20, eig = T)
my_var_CLR=round(mypcoa_CLR$eig*100/sum(mypcoa_CLR$eig),2)[1:20]
barplot (my_var_CLR)
mypcoa_df_CLR=as.data.frame(mypcoa_CLR$points)
names(mypcoa_df_CLR) <- c('PC1','PC2','PC3','PC4','PC5', 'PC6','PC7','PC8','PC9','PC10',
                          'PC11','PC12','PC13','PC14','PC15', 'PC16','PC17','PC18','PC19','PC20')
phenos_imputed_div_pc_CLR=merge(mypcoa_df_CLR,phenos_imputed_div, by="row.names")
row.names (phenos_imputed_div_pc_CLR)<-phenos_imputed_div_pc_CLR$Row.names

legend_out("Analysed infant samples (total)", phenos_imputed_div %>% n_si())
legend_out("Species in the Aitchison distance (after removing probiotic species)",
           sprintf("%d species, pseudocount %.3g", ncol(taxa_sp_filt), my_pseudocount_normal))
```

```{r}
#Figure 3A Beta Diversity PCoA — Escherichia coli presence/absence

# Check the exact column name first
ecoli_col <- colnames(taxa_sp)[grep("Escherichia_coli", colnames(taxa_sp), ignore.case = TRUE)]
cat("E. coli column found:", ecoli_col, "\n")

# Add presence/absence to the PCoA data frame
phenos_imputed_div_pc_CLR$ecoli <- factor(
  ifelse(taxa_sp[rownames(phenos_imputed_div_pc_CLR), ecoli_col] > 0, "Present", "Absent"),
  levels = c("Absent", "Present")
)

cat(sprintf("E. coli Absent:  %d\n", sum(phenos_imputed_div_pc_CLR$ecoli == "Absent",  na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("E. coli Present: %d\n", sum(phenos_imputed_div_pc_CLR$ecoli == "Present", na.rm = TRUE)))

# ── PCoA plot ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

ecoli_plot <- ggplot(
    phenos_imputed_div_pc_CLR %>% filter(!is.na(ecoli)),
    aes(PC1, PC2, color = ecoli)
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = ecoli, fill = ecoli),
               type = "norm", linetype = 2, geom = "path",
               alpha = 0.8, show.legend = TRUE) +
  xlab(paste0("PCo1 = ", round(my_var_CLR[1], 2), "%")) +
  ylab(paste0("PCo2 = ", round(my_var_CLR[2], 2), "%")) +
  scale_colour_manual(name   = "E. coli",
                      values = c("Absent" = "#1f77b4", "Present" = "#ff7f0e")) +
  scale_fill_manual(name     = "E. coli",
                    values   = c("Absent" = "#1f77b4", "Present" = "#ff7f0e")) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4, shape = 16))) +
  theme(
    plot.subtitle       = element_text(vjust = 1),
    plot.caption        = element_text(vjust = 1),
    axis.title.x        = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.title.y        = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.line.x         = element_line(),
    axis.line.y         = element_line(),
    legend.position     = "bottom",
    legend.title        = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text         = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.key          = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major    = element_line(colour = NA),
    panel.grid.minor    = element_line(colour = NA),
    panel.background    = element_rect(fill = NA)
  )

# ── Add marginal histograms ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

ecoli_plot <- ggExtra::ggMarginal(
  ecoli_plot,
  type        = "histogram",
  groupColour = FALSE,
  groupFill   = TRUE,
  xparams     = list(bins = 60, alpha = 0.8, position = "identity", color = "white"),
  yparams     = list(bins = 60, alpha = 0.8, position = "identity", color = "white")
)

# ── Display & save ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

ecoli_plot

ggsave(filename = "3A_PCoA_Ecoli_presence.pdf",
       plot     = ecoli_plot,
       width    = 6,
       height   = 5,
       dpi      = 300)

cat("✓ Saved: 3A_PCoA_Ecoli_presence.pdf\n")

# ── LEGEND NUMBERS: Fig. 2a ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
# E. coli itself contributes to the distance, so the test is repeated with
# E. coli removed from the distance.
pc2a <- phenos_imputed_div_pc_CLR %>% as.data.frame() %>% filter(!is.na(ecoli))
legend_out("Fig 2a — plotted samples / infants by E. coli status", pc2a %>% n_si(ecoli))
legend_out("Fig 2a — infants contributing to both groups",
           as.character(length(intersect(pc2a$MM_ID[pc2a$ecoli == "Present"],
                                         pc2a$MM_ID[pc2a$ecoli == "Absent"]))))

dat2a  <- pc2a %>% filter(!is.na(Clean_reads_P1), !is.na(DNA_conc))
d_full <- as.matrix(my_distance_CLR)[rownames(dat2a), rownames(dat2a)]
ecoli_filt_col <- grep("Escherichia_coli", colnames(taxa_sp_filt), value = TRUE)
d_noec <- as.matrix(vegdist(taxa_sp_filt[rownames(dat2a),
                                         setdiff(colnames(taxa_sp_filt), ecoli_filt_col)],
                            method = "aitchison", pseudocount = my_pseudocount_normal))

run_perm_2a <- function(d, label) {
  set.seed(42)
  ad <- adonis2(as.dist(d) ~ Clean_reads_P1 + DNA_conc + ecoli, data = dat2a,
                permutations = 10000, by = "margin")
  sprintf("%s: n = %d samples / %d infants | R2 = %.3f | F = %.2f | p = %.2g",
          label, nrow(dat2a), dplyr::n_distinct(dat2a$MM_ID),
          ad["ecoli", "R2"], ad["ecoli", "F"], ad["ecoli", "Pr(>F)"])
}
legend_out("Fig 2a — PERMANOVA, E. coli presence (marginal SS, + reads + DNA conc, 10,000 permutations)",
           c(run_perm_2a(d_full, "distance as plotted"),
             run_perm_2a(d_noec, "E. coli removed from distance")))
legend_out("Fig 2a — PCoA variance explained (%)",
           sprintf("PCo1 %.2f | PCo2 %.2f", my_var_CLR[1], my_var_CLR[2]))
legend_out("Fig 2a — presence definition",
           sprintf("E. coli relative abundance > 0 (column: %s)", ecoli_col))
```

```{r}
# 3B E. Coli absence presence based on delivery mode

ecoli_col <- colnames(taxa_sp_filt_CLR)[
  grep("Escherichia_coli", colnames(taxa_sp_filt_CLR), ignore.case = TRUE)
]
cat("E. coli CLR column found:", ecoli_col, "\n")

# Add E. coli CLR values to phenotype data frame
phenos_imputed_div$ecoli_CLR <- taxa_sp_filt_CLR[
  rownames(phenos_imputed_div), ecoli_col
]

# ── Factor encoding (unconditional) ──────────────────────────────────────────
phenos_imputed_div$delivery_md <- factor(
  phenos_imputed_div$delivery_md,
  levels = c(0, 1),
  labels = c("Vaginal", "Caesarean")
)

phenos_imputed_div$week <- factor(
  phenos_imputed_div$week,
  levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "7", "8"),
  labels = c("W1", "W2", "W3", "W4", "W5", "W6", "W7", "W8")
)

# ── Statistical tests (Wilcoxon, BH-corrected, per week) ─────────────────────
stat_tests <- phenos_imputed_div %>%
  filter(!is.na(ecoli_CLR) & !is.na(delivery_md) & !is.na(week)) %>%
  group_by(week) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(delivery_md) == 2) %>%
  summarise(
    p_value  = suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(ecoli_CLR ~ delivery_md, exact = FALSE)$p.value),
    y_pos    = max(ecoli_CLR, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.2,
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj        = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    significance = case_when(
      p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE          ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# ── Plot data ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plot_data <- phenos_imputed_div %>%
  filter(!is.na(ecoli_CLR) & !is.na(delivery_md) & !is.na(week))

# ── Plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ecoli_delivery_plot <- ggplot(plot_data,
                              aes(x = week, y = ecoli_CLR,
                                  fill = delivery_md, color = delivery_md)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("Vaginal" = "#ff7f0e", "Caesarean" = "#1f77b4")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Vaginal" = "#ff7f0e", "Caesarean" = "#1f77b4")) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.4, outlier.colour = NA) +
  geom_point(
    alpha    = 0.6,
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.3, jitter.height = 0)
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data        = stat_tests,
    aes(x = week, y = y_pos, label = significance),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size        = 5,
    na.rm       = TRUE
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x     = "Postnatal Week",
    y     = "E. coli Abundance (CLR)",
    fill  = "Delivery Mode",
    color = "Delivery Mode",
    caption = " "
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.title.y    = element_text(color = "black", size = 18),
    axis.title.x    = element_text(color = "black", size = 18),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 12, angle = 60, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 14),
    plot.caption    = element_text(size = 8, color = "grey50")
  )

print(ecoli_delivery_plot)

ggsave("3B_Ecoli_CLR_delivery_mode_weeks.pdf",
       plot   = ecoli_delivery_plot,
       width  = 6,
       height = 5,
       dpi    = 300)

cat("✓ Saved: 3B_Ecoli_CLR_delivery_mode_weeks.pdf\n")

# ── Sample counts per week and delivery mode ──────────────────────────────────
sample_counts <- phenos_imputed_div %>%
  filter(!is.na(ecoli_CLR), !is.na(delivery_md), !is.na(week)) %>%
  group_by(week, delivery_md) %>%
  summarise(N_samples = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from  = delivery_md,
              values_from = N_samples,
              values_fill = 0)

print(sample_counts)

# ── LEGEND NUMBERS: Fig. 2b ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
legend_out("Fig 2b — samples / infants per week and delivery mode",
           plot_data %>% n_si(week, delivery_md))
legend_out("Fig 2b — per-week Wilcoxon rank-sum (two-sided), BH across the weeks tested",
           stat_tests %>% transmute(week, p_value = signif(p_value, 3),
                                    p_adj = signif(p_adj, 3), significance))

# Overall test: linear mixed model with a random intercept per infant, same
# covariates as the other mixed models; likelihood-ratio test.
dat2b <- plot_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Postnatal_Age), !is.na(Clean_reads_P1), !is.na(DNA_conc)) %>%
  mutate(across(c(Postnatal_Age, Clean_reads_P1, DNA_conc), ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)),
                .names = "{.col}_z"))
m0_2b <- lmer(ecoli_CLR ~ Postnatal_Age_z + Clean_reads_P1_z + DNA_conc_z + (1 | MM_ID),
              data = dat2b, REML = FALSE)
m1_2b <- update(m0_2b, . ~ . + delivery_md)
lrt_2b <- anova(m1_2b, m0_2b)
cf_2b  <- summary(m1_2b)$coefficients
legend_out("Fig 2b — overall: LMM, E. coli CLR ~ delivery mode + postnatal age + reads + DNA conc + (1|infant)",
           sprintf("n = %d samples / %d infants | effect (caesarean vs vaginal) = %.2f (SE %.2f) | LRT p = %.2g",
                   nrow(dat2b), dplyr::n_distinct(dat2b$MM_ID),
                   cf_2b["delivery_mdCaesarean", "Estimate"],
                   cf_2b["delivery_mdCaesarean", "Std. Error"],
                   lrt_2b[["Pr(>Chisq)"]][2]))
legend_out("Fig 2b — infants per delivery mode (overall)",
           plot_data %>% dplyr::distinct(MM_ID, delivery_md) %>% dplyr::count(delivery_md))
```

```{r}
# -------------------------
# Libraries
# -------------------------
library(tidyverse)
library(ape)
library(ggtree)
library(cowplot)

# -------------------------
# File paths
# -------------------------
tree_file <- "RAxML_bestTree.t__SGB10068.StrainPhlAn4.tre"
meta_file <- "metadata_cleaned_april.txt"

# -------------------------
# Load & clean metadata
# -------------------------
meta <- read.delim(meta_file) %>%
  mutate(
    ID           = as.character(ID),
    label        = ID,
    SampleType   = trimws(as.character(SampleType)),
    SampleType   = factor(SampleType, levels = c("maternal", "infant")),
    family_group = as.character(family_group)
  ) %>%
  filter(SampleType %in% c("maternal", "infant"))

# -------------------------
# Family group colour palette

# -------------------------
family_groups <- sort(unique(meta$family_group))
n_families    <- length(family_groups)

palette_120 <- c(
  "#1f77b4", "#ff7f0e", "#55e058", "#654ee6", "#67e6d5", "#c27070",
  "#97bd62", "#ab87e0", "#9cc8e6", "#443b94", "#e04848", "#e09d65",
  "#55e096", "#4e74e6", "#80bd90", "#a6e055", "#9ca7e6", "#55b6bd",
  "#c2663e", "#5c6ab8", "#4eb0e6", "#48bd55", "#936ce0", "#7d97b8",
  "#3e3eb8", "#c2e099", "#c28d70", "#4e92e6", "#3b7594", "#e06b65",
  "#8ee075", "#48bd8a", "#867db8", "#8adfe6", "#80bdac", "#99e0a1",
  "#80bd48", "#3b5a94", "#55a1bd", "#62bd6d", "#e08548", "#99e0be",
  "#b4e075", "#67cae6", "#e09082", "#3e57b8", "#55e0b9", "#9ebd80",
  "#55e07a", "#55bda4", "#e06648", "#e08465", "#4e5de6", "#7384e6",
  "#c24b3e", "#e0ad82", "#84e055", "#715dc2", "#c26757", "#4ea1e6",
  "#3e8db8", "#8974c2", "#3b4d94", "#9cb6e6", "#c27d57", "#5c85b8",
  "#75e0a7", "#3b6894", "#5c77b8", "#75e087", "#a79ce6", "#c2793e",
  "#3e4bb8", "#c25757", "#7cbd62", "#7873e6", "#71b0bd", "#67e3e6",
  "#73bde6", "#e07648", "#e09e82", "#55bdb4", "#e08282", "#63bd48",
  "#7da3b8", "#7d89b8", "#8ae6d9", "#73ace6", "#c27d70", "#85bd80",
  "#738fe6", "#62bd95", "#739be6", "#48bd78", "#5c60b8", "#62bd7f",
  "#8ad2e6", "#4e83e6", "#75e0c2", "#ade099", "#e09065", "#75e076",
  "#67d7e6", "#48bd67", "#75e097", "#55e0a4", "#3e6fb8", "#99e0af",
  "#71bdba", "#c2583e", "#e05748", "#e07765", "#3e63b8", "#55e088",
  "#c27257", "#55e06c", "#c28757", "#80bda0", "#99e0cc", "#c23e3e"
)

if (n_families > length(palette_120)) {
  stop(sprintf(
    "Found %d families but the palette only has %d colours. Add more entries to palette_120.",
    n_families, length(palette_120)
  ))
}

# Map the first n_families colours onto the (sorted) family groups.
family_colors <- setNames(palette_120[seq_len(n_families)], family_groups)

cat("Families:", n_families, "- colours assigned:", length(family_colors), "\n")
scales::show_col(family_colors)

# -------------------------
# Load tree & clean tip labels
# -------------------------
tree <- read.tree(tree_file)

tree$tip.label <- sub("^(([^_]*_){3}).*$", "\\1", tree$tip.label)
tree$tip.label <- sub("_$", "", tree$tip.label)
n_tips_raw_2c <- length(tree$tip.label)

# -------------------------
# Drop ALL tips not in metadata (controls + unmatched)
# -------------------------
tips_to_drop <- tree$tip.label[!tree$tip.label %in% meta$label]

if (length(tips_to_drop) > 0) {
  cat("Dropping", length(tips_to_drop), "tips not in metadata:\n")
  cat(paste(" -", tips_to_drop, collapse = "\n"), "\n")
  tree <- drop.tip(tree, tips_to_drop)
}

# -------------------------
# Join tip labels to metadata
# -------------------------
tip_data <- data.frame(label = tree$tip.label) %>%
  left_join(meta, by = "label") %>%
  filter(!is.na(SampleType)) %>%
  mutate(
    fill_color = family_colors[family_group],
    tip_label  = ""
  )

# -------------------------
# Shape mapping (maternal = circle, infant = triangle)
# -------------------------
sampletype_shapes <- c(
  maternal = 21,
  infant   = 24
)

sampletype_labels <- c(
  maternal = "Maternal",
  infant   = "Infant"
)

# -------------------------
# Tree plot
# Two tip-point layers so circles (maternal) always draw on top of
# triangles (infant). Both map shape = SampleType -> single merged legend.
# -------------------------
p_ecoli <- ggtree(tree, layout = "dendrogram", color = "grey30", size = 0.4) %<+% tip_data +

  # Layer 1: infant triangles (drawn first / underneath)
  geom_tippoint(
    data   = ~ subset(.x, SampleType == "infant"),
    aes(fill = I(fill_color), shape = SampleType),
    size   = 3,
    color  = "black",
    stroke = 0.5
  ) +

  # Layer 2: maternal circles (drawn last / always on top)
  geom_tippoint(
    data   = ~ subset(.x, SampleType == "maternal"),
    aes(fill = I(fill_color), shape = SampleType),
    size   = 3.5,
    color  = "black",
    stroke = 0.5
  ) +

  scale_shape_manual(
    values = sampletype_shapes,
    name   = "Sample type",
    labels = sampletype_labels,
    guide  = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(
        size   = 4,
        fill   = "white",
        color  = "black",
        stroke = 0.6
      )
    )
  ) +

  theme_tree() +
  theme(
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.position  = c(0.8, 0.8),
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text        = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks       = element_blank(),
    axis.title       = element_blank(),
    axis.line        = element_blank(),
    plot.margin      = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  )

p_ecoli

ggsave(
  "3C_SGB10068_Ecoli_tree.pdf",
  plot   = p_ecoli,
  width  = 6,
  height = 5
)

cat("Saved: SGB10068_Ecoli_tree.pdf\n")

# ── LEGEND NUMBERS: Fig. 2c ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
legend_out("Fig 2c — tips in StrainPhlAn tree (SGB10068)",
           sprintf("in tree file: %d | dropped (no metadata match): %d | plotted: %d",
                   n_tips_raw_2c, length(tips_to_drop), nrow(tip_data)))
if (length(tips_to_drop)) legend_out("Fig 2c — dropped tip labels", tips_to_drop)
legend_out("Fig 2c — plotted tips by sample type (samples; individuals; families)",
           tip_data %>% dplyr::group_by(SampleType) %>%
             dplyr::summarise(n_samples = dplyr::n(),
                              n_individuals = dplyr::n_distinct(MM_ID),
                              n_families = dplyr::n_distinct(family_group),
                              .groups = "drop"))
legend_out("Fig 2c — families with both a maternal and an infant tip",
           as.character(length(intersect(tip_data$family_group[tip_data$SampleType == "maternal"],
                                         tip_data$family_group[tip_data$SampleType == "infant"]))))
```

```{r}
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Figure 3D — mother–infant strain distances, Related vs Unrelated
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
library(tidyverse)
count <- dplyr::count          # plyr also exports count(); pin to dplyr

# ── Per-SGB summary table (FDR per species) ───────────────────────────────
distances <- read_csv("Strain_transmission_mickey_mouse(all_species_related_versus_unre).csv") %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(SGB),
    !str_starts(SGB, "\\*"),
    !str_starts(SGB, "Showing"),
    !is.na(median_related),
    !is.na(median_unrelated),
    n_related > 10
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    SGB = recode(SGB,
      "t__SGB1815"  = "Phocaeicola dorei",
      "t__SGB10068" = "Escherichia coli",
      "t__SGB8002"  = "Streptococcus thermophilus",
      "t__SGB17248" = "Bifidobacterium longum"
    )
  )

# ── DistMat sources for the four focal species ────────────────────────────
sgb_files <- c(
  "t__SGB1815_DistMat.txt"  = "Phocaeicola dorei",
  "t__SGB10068_DistMat.txt" = "Escherichia coli",
  "t__SGB8002_DistMat.txt"  = "Streptococcus thermophilus",
  "t__SGB17248_DistMat.txt" = "Bifidobacterium longum"
)

# ── one DistMat -> long mother–infant pairwise table (dup-safe) ───────────
# IDs: {M|B}{family}_{tp}_{well}.  M = maternal, B = infant, digits = family.
read_mi_pairs <- function(file, sgb_name) {
  ids <- scan(file, what = "", sep = "\t", nlines = 1, quiet = TRUE)   # column IDs
  raw <- read.table(file, header = FALSE, sep = "\t", skip = 1,
                    check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  labs <- raw[[1]]
  m <- as.matrix(raw[, -1]); storage.mode(m) <- "numeric"
  rownames(m) <- labs
  colnames(m) <- ids

  # drop any sample whose label is duplicated (matches the tree dedup step)
  dup <- unique(labs[duplicated(labs)])
  if (length(dup)) {
    message(sgb_name, ": dropping ", length(dup),
            " duplicated label(s): ", paste(dup, collapse = ", "))
    m <- m[!rownames(m) %in% dup, !colnames(m) %in% dup, drop = FALSE]
  }

  m[upper.tri(m, diag = TRUE)] <- NA              # each pair once, drop self-pairs

  as.data.frame(as.table(m)) %>%
    setNames(c("ID1", "ID2", "dist")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(dist)) %>%
    mutate(
      ID1 = as.character(ID1), ID2 = as.character(ID2),
      nGD   = dist / max(dist, na.rm = TRUE),       # normalise per SGB (all pairs)
      type1 = str_sub(ID1, 1, 1), type2 = str_sub(ID2, 1, 1),
      fam1  = str_extract(ID1, "(?<=^[A-Za-z])[0-9]+"),
      fam2  = str_extract(ID2, "(?<=^[A-Za-z])[0-9]+")
    ) %>%
    filter((type1 == "M" & type2 == "B") | (type1 == "B" & type2 == "M")) %>%
    mutate(Group = ifelse(fam1 == fam2, "Related", "Unrelated"),
           SGB   = sgb_name) %>%
    select(SGB, ID1, ID2, dist, nGD, Group)
}

strain_long <- map2_dfr(names(sgb_files), unname(sgb_files), read_mi_pairs) %>%
  mutate(SGB   = factor(SGB,   levels = unname(sgb_files)),
         Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Related", "Unrelated")))

# sanity check vs n_related in the CSV  (SGB1815 should read 14 / 952)
strain_long %>% count(SGB, Group) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = n) %>% print()

# ── FDR stars from the summary table (one per SGB) ────────────────────────
# y placed ABOVE the top whisker so the star clears the box.
sig_labels <- distances %>%
  filter(SGB %in% unname(sgb_files)) %>%
  mutate(SGB   = factor(SGB, levels = unname(sgb_files)),
         label = case_when(FDR < 0.001 ~ "***", FDR < 0.01 ~ "**",
                           FDR < 0.05  ~ "*",   TRUE ~ "")) %>%
  filter(label != "") %>%
  left_join(strain_long %>% group_by(SGB) %>%
              summarise(y = max(nGD) * 1.12, .groups = "drop"), by = "SGB")

# ── abbreviate species names (e.g. "P. dorei"); keep panel order ──────────
abbr <- c("Phocaeicola dorei"          = "P. dorei",
          "Escherichia coli"           = "E. coli",
          "Streptococcus thermophilus" = "S. thermophilus",
          "Bifidobacterium longum"     = "B. longum")

strain_long <- strain_long %>% mutate(SGB = recode_factor(SGB, !!!abbr))
sig_labels  <- sig_labels  %>% mutate(SGB = recode_factor(SGB, !!!abbr))

# ── plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_strain <- ggplot(strain_long, aes(Group, nGD, fill = Group)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.45, outlier.shape = NA, colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_jitter(aes(fill = Group), width = 0.12, shape = 21, size = 1.3,
              stroke = 0.3, colour = "grey30", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_text(data = sig_labels, aes(x = 1.5, y = y, label = label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5, vjust = 0) +
  facet_wrap(~ SGB, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.18))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Related" = "#1f77b4", "Unrelated" = "#a6cee3")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "normalised phylogenetic distance (nGD)",
       title = "Mothers share closer strains with their own infants") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold"),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold.italic"),
        legend.position  = "none")

print(p_strain)
ggsave("3D_strain_distance_boxplot.pdf", plot = p_strain, width = 9, height = 3.5)

# ── LEGEND NUMBERS: Fig. 2d ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Each point is a mother SAMPLE x infant SAMPLE pair, so one mother-infant dyad
# can contribute many points. Report pairs AND the distinct people behind them.
pairs_2d <- strain_long %>%
  mutate(mother = ifelse(str_sub(ID1, 1, 1) == "M", ID1, ID2),
         infant = ifelse(str_sub(ID1, 1, 1) == "B", ID1, ID2),
         mother_ind = str_extract(mother, "^[A-Za-z][0-9]+"),
         infant_ind = str_extract(infant, "^[A-Za-z][0-9]+"))
legend_out("Fig 2d — points per species and group (sample pairs; distinct mothers; distinct infants; distinct dyads)",
           pairs_2d %>% dplyr::group_by(SGB, Group) %>%
             dplyr::summarise(n_sample_pairs = dplyr::n(),
                              n_mothers = dplyr::n_distinct(mother_ind),
                              n_infants = dplyr::n_distinct(infant_ind),
                              n_dyads   = dplyr::n_distinct(paste(mother_ind, infant_ind)),
                              .groups = "drop"))

# Relatedness check: Group is taken from the ID digits (M056 ~ B056) and
# compared with family_group in the metadata.
fam_lookup <- metadata %>% transmute(ID = as.character(ID), family_group = as.character(family_group))
rel_check <- pairs_2d %>%
  left_join(fam_lookup, by = c("mother" = "ID")) %>% dplyr::rename(fam_m = family_group) %>%
  left_join(fam_lookup, by = c("infant" = "ID")) %>% dplyr::rename(fam_i = family_group) %>%
  mutate(Group_meta = case_when(is.na(fam_m) | is.na(fam_i) ~ "no metadata",
                                fam_m == fam_i ~ "Related", TRUE ~ "Unrelated"))
legend_out("Fig 2d — relatedness check: ID digits (Group) vs metadata family_group (Group_meta)",
           rel_check %>% dplyr::count(SGB, Group, Group_meta))

legend_out("Fig 2d — summary CSV rows for the four plotted species (source of the FDR stars)",
           distances %>% filter(SGB %in% unname(sgb_files)))
legend_out("Fig 2d — summary CSV",
           sprintf("species rows after filtering (n_related > 10): %d | columns: %s",
                   nrow(distances), paste(colnames(distances), collapse = ", ")))
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# SGB10068 — three-group cohort division based on maternal sample availability
# and strain sharing
# =============================================================================

sgb <- readRDS("t__SGB10068.rds")

# ── Step 1: Extract all infant MM_IDs present in the dataset ─────────────────
all_infant_mmids <- unique(c(
  as.character(sgb$MM_ID_short_1[sgb$Type_1 == "infant"]),
  as.character(sgb$MM_ID_short_2[sgb$Type_2 == "infant"])
))
all_infant_mmids <- all_infant_mmids[!is.na(all_infant_mmids)]
cat(sprintf("Total infants in dataset: %d\n", length(all_infant_mmids)))

# ── Step 2: Infants with a related maternal sample ────────────────────────────
# mother_infant == "yes"  → one side maternal, one infant
# related       == "related" → same family (excludes unrelated cross-type pairs)

related_mi <- sgb[sgb$mother_infant == "yes" & sgb$related == "related", ]

infant_mm_related <- unique(c(
  as.character(related_mi$MM_ID_short_1[related_mi$Type_1 == "infant"]),
  as.character(related_mi$MM_ID_short_2[related_mi$Type_2 == "infant"])
))
infant_mm_related <- infant_mm_related[!is.na(infant_mm_related)]
cat(sprintf("Infants with a related maternal sample: %d\n",
            length(infant_mm_related)))

# ── Step 3: Infants with strain sharing in >= 1 related mother-infant pair ────
related_mi_sharing <- related_mi[related_mi$Strain_sharing == "yes", ]

infant_mm_sharing <- unique(c(
  as.character(related_mi_sharing$MM_ID_short_1[related_mi_sharing$Type_1 == "infant"]),
  as.character(related_mi_sharing$MM_ID_short_2[related_mi_sharing$Type_2 == "infant"])
))
infant_mm_sharing <- infant_mm_sharing[!is.na(infant_mm_sharing)]
cat(sprintf("Infants with strain sharing (>= 1 sample): %d\n",
            length(infant_mm_sharing)))

# ── Step 4: Assign groups ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Group C: related maternal sample AND strain sharing detected in >= 1 pair
# Group B: related maternal sample BUT no strain sharing detected
# Group A: no related maternal sample (SGB absent in mother, or no maternal sample)

sgb_groups <- data.frame(
  MM_ID = all_infant_mmids,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    MM_ID              = as.character(MM_ID),
    has_maternal_sample = MM_ID %in% infant_mm_related,
    has_strain_sharing  = MM_ID %in% infant_mm_sharing,
    sgb10068_group = case_when(
      has_strain_sharing  ~ "C_strain_sharing",
      has_maternal_sample ~ "B_maternal_no_sharing",
      TRUE                ~ "A_no_maternal_sample"
    )
  )

cat("\n=== Group sizes (infants in SGB10068 pairwise file) ===\n")
print(table(sgb_groups$sgb10068_group))

# ── Step 5: nGD summary by group (sanity check) ───────────────────────────────
# nGD should be very low (< ~0.01) for strain-sharing pairs, high for unrelated.

nGD_summary <- related_mi %>%
  mutate(
    infant_MM_ID = case_when(
      Type_1 == "infant" ~ as.character(MM_ID_short_1),
      Type_2 == "infant" ~ as.character(MM_ID_short_2)
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(infant_MM_ID)) %>%
  left_join(sgb_groups %>% select(MM_ID, sgb10068_group),
            by = c("infant_MM_ID" = "MM_ID")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(sgb10068_group)) %>%
  group_by(sgb10068_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_pairs    = n(),
    median_nGD = median(nGD, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_nGD    = min(nGD,    na.rm = TRUE),
    max_nGD    = max(nGD,    na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups    = "drop"
  )

cat("\n=== nGD summary by group (related mother-infant pairs only) ===\n")
print(nGD_summary)

# ── Step 6: Merge into metadata_infant ───────────────────────────────────────
# Infants not in the SGB10068 pairwise file at all (SGB absent in all their
# samples and their mother's samples) will receive NA — relabelled below as
# "A_no_maternal_sample" for consistency.

metadata_infant2 <- metadata_infant %>%
  mutate(MM_ID = as.character(MM_ID)) %>%
  left_join(
    sgb_groups %>%
      mutate(MM_ID = as.character(MM_ID)) %>%
      select(MM_ID, sgb10068_group, has_maternal_sample, has_strain_sharing),
    by = "MM_ID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sgb10068_group = if_else(is.na(sgb10068_group),
                             "A_no_maternal_sample",
                             sgb10068_group),
    has_maternal_sample = if_else(is.na(has_maternal_sample),
                                  FALSE, has_maternal_sample),
    has_strain_sharing  = if_else(is.na(has_strain_sharing),
                                  FALSE, has_strain_sharing),
    # Ordered factor for clean plot ordering
    sgb10068_group = factor(sgb10068_group,
                            levels = c("A_no_maternal_sample",
                                       "B_maternal_no_sharing",
                                       "C_strain_sharing"),
                            labels = c("No maternal sample",
                                       "Maternal sample,\nno strain sharing",
                                       "Maternal sample,\nstrain sharing"))
  )

cat("\n=== Final group assignment across full metadata_infant ===\n")
print(table(metadata_infant2$sgb10068_group, useNA = "ifany"))

# ── Verify: inspect the qualifying sample-pairs for each group C infant ───────
group_c_evidence <- related_mi_sharing %>%
  mutate(
    infant_MM_ID    = case_when(
      Type_1 == "infant" ~ as.character(MM_ID_short_1),
      Type_2 == "infant" ~ as.character(MM_ID_short_2)
    ),
    infant_sample   = case_when(
      Type_1 == "infant" ~ Sample_ID_1,
      Type_2 == "infant" ~ Sample_ID_2
    ),
    maternal_sample = case_when(
      Type_1 == "maternal" ~ Sample_ID_1,
      Type_2 == "maternal" ~ Sample_ID_2
    ),
    infant_timepoint = case_when(
      Type_1 == "infant" ~ as.character(Timepoint_categorical_1),
      Type_2 == "infant" ~ as.character(Timepoint_categorical_2)
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(infant_MM_ID)) %>%          # ← drops rows where neither side is infant
  select(infant_MM_ID, infant_sample, infant_timepoint,
         maternal_sample, nGD, Strain_sharing) %>%
  arrange(infant_MM_ID, nGD)

cat("=== Sample-level evidence for group C infants ===\n")
print(group_c_evidence)

# ── LEGEND NUMBERS: Fig. 2c (strain sharing) ──────────────────────────────────
legend_out("Fig 2c — infants by E. coli strain-sharing group (infants in the SGB10068 pairwise file)",
           sgb_groups %>% dplyr::count(sgb10068_group))
legend_out("Fig 2c — related mother-infant sample pairs, by strain-sharing call (nGD range shows the threshold used)",
           related_mi %>% dplyr::group_by(Strain_sharing) %>%
             dplyr::summarise(n_pairs = dplyr::n(), min_nGD = min(nGD, na.rm = TRUE),
                              max_nGD = max(nGD, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"))
legend_out("Fig 2c — infants with >= 1 shared strain, as % of infants with a related maternal sample",
           sprintf("%d of %d (%.1f%%)", length(infant_mm_sharing), length(infant_mm_related),
                   100 * length(infant_mm_sharing) / max(1, length(infant_mm_related))))

# ── How many qualifying timepoints per group C infant? ────────────────────────
cat("\n=== Number of strain-sharing timepoints per group C infant ===\n")
group_c_evidence %>%
  group_by(infant_MM_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    n_sharing_timepoints = n(),
    min_nGD              = min(nGD),
    max_nGD              = max(nGD),
    timepoints           = paste(sort(as.numeric(infant_timepoint)), collapse = ", "),
    .groups              = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(min_nGD) %>%
  print()
```

```{r}
# ── Percentage of total samples showing strain sharing per group C infant ──────

# Step 1: count total samples per infant from metadata_infant
total_samples <- metadata_infant %>%
  mutate(MM_ID_short = sub("^B0*", "", sub("_.*", "", rownames(.)))) %>%
  group_by(MM_ID_short) %>%
  summarise(total_samples = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Step 2: join with the per-infant strain-sharing summary and calculate %
cat("\n=== Strain-sharing timepoints as % of total samples per group C infant ===\n")
group_c_evidence %>%
  group_by(infant_MM_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    n_sharing_timepoints = n(),
    min_nGD              = min(nGD),
    max_nGD              = max(nGD),
    timepoints           = paste(sort(as.numeric(infant_timepoint)), collapse = ", "),
    .groups              = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(total_samples, by = c("infant_MM_ID" = "MM_ID_short")) %>%
  mutate(
    pct_sharing = round(100 * n_sharing_timepoints / total_samples, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(min_nGD) %>%
  select(infant_MM_ID, n_sharing_timepoints, total_samples,
         pct_sharing, min_nGD, max_nGD, timepoints) %>%
  { 
    print(.)
    cat(sprintf(
  "\nMedian sharing: %.0f/%.0f samples (%.1f%%) per infant\n",
  median(.$n_sharing_timepoints),
  median(.$total_samples),
  median(.$pct_sharing)
))
    invisible(.)
  }
```

```{r}
#Supplement E. coli/Klebsiella association

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CLR E. coli vs K. pneumoniae correlation
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
library(tidyverse)

# ── Resolve the two target columns ───────────────────────────────────────────
ecoli_col <- colnames(taxa_sp_filt_CLR)[
  grep("Escherichia_coli", colnames(taxa_sp_filt_CLR), ignore.case = TRUE)
]
kleb_col <- colnames(taxa_sp_filt_CLR)[
  grep("Klebsiella_pneumoniae", colnames(taxa_sp_filt_CLR), ignore.case = TRUE)
]

if (length(ecoli_col) != 1)
  stop("Expected 1 E. coli column, got ", length(ecoli_col), ": ",
       paste(ecoli_col, collapse = ", "))
if (length(kleb_col) != 1)
  stop("Expected 1 K. pneumoniae column, got ", length(kleb_col), ": ",
       paste(kleb_col, collapse = ", "))

# ── Assemble plotting frame ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
corr_df <- taxa_sp_filt_CLR %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("ID") %>%
  select(ID, Ecoli = all_of(ecoli_col), Kleb = all_of(kleb_col)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Ecoli), !is.na(Kleb))

# Optional: join week for colouring (mirrors 1F). Adjust the source/key if the
# IDs don't line up; drop this block to get a single-colour scatter.
corr_df <- corr_df %>%
  left_join(phenos_imputed_div_pc_CLR %>% select(ID, week, MM_ID), by = "ID")

# ── Correlation statistic (sample-level; see mixed-model note below) ──────────
ct  <- cor.test(corr_df$Ecoli, corr_df$Kleb, method = "pearson")
rho <- cor(corr_df$Ecoli, corr_df$Kleb, method = "spearman")

lab <- sprintf("Pearson r = %.2f  (p %s)\nSpearman \u03c1 = %.2f\nn = %d",
               ct$estimate,
               ifelse(ct$p.value < 0.001, "< 0.001", sprintf("= %.3f", ct$p.value)),
               rho, nrow(corr_df))

# ── Plot ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_corr <- ggplot(corr_df, aes(x = Ecoli, y = Kleb)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = week), alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black",
              fill = "grey70", linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.25) +
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = lab,
           hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.2, size = 3.6, lineheight = 0.95) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = "Week", option = "D",
                        breaks = 1:8, limits = c(1, 8)) +
  labs(x = expression(italic("E. coli")~"(CLR abundance)"),
       y = expression(italic("K. pneumoniae")~"(CLR abundance)")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x     = element_text(color = "black", size = 18),
    axis.title.y     = element_text(color = "black", size = 18),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.line.x      = element_line(),
    axis.line.y      = element_line(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = NA),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = NA),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 14, vjust = 0.9),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm")
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5,
                                barwidth = 8, barheight = 0.8))

print(p_corr)
ggsave("2supplement_Ecoli_Kpneumoniae_CLR_correlation.pdf", plot = p_corr,
       width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300)

# ── LEGEND NUMBERS: Supplementary E. coli vs K. pneumoniae ────────────────────
# Pearson/Spearman treat every sample as independent; a mixed model with a
# random intercept per infant is reported alongside.
m_corr <- lmer(scale(Kleb) ~ scale(Ecoli) + (1 | MM_ID), data = corr_df, REML = FALSE)
m_corr0 <- update(m_corr, . ~ . - scale(Ecoli))
legend_out("Supp — E. coli vs K. pneumoniae (CLR)",
           sprintf("n = %d samples / %d infants | Pearson r = %.2f, p = %.2g | Spearman rho = %.2f | LMM standardised beta = %.2f, LRT p = %.2g",
                   nrow(corr_df), dplyr::n_distinct(corr_df$MM_ID), ct$estimate, ct$p.value, rho,
                   fixef(m_corr)[2], anova(m_corr, m_corr0)[["Pr(>Chisq)"]][2]))
```
